content:
Running into this, I'm using the tagged mathlib 4.33.1 commit it lists, but for some reason that doesn't pass the ancestry check against mathlib master? I do have some passing Comparator/Nanoda builds on the repo

Repo: kimihiro64/Robin1984
Commit: 160cd08e5525e3769461e2f7e206b996ff51aa83
Lean: v4.33.1
Latest verification run: https://github.com/PalomarRegistry/PalomarSubmission/actions/runs/33450195364

The codex suggestion was to pin mathlib back at 4.33.0 which it says would pass the check, but I'd rather not since that probably introduces some more necessary code changes.

I had codex dig into it, the verify was only treating ancestors of master as official, but development is occurring on master so it begins excluding older but still official tagged releases. My guess is at least some older release versions should be accepted, especially since 34 is still in release candidate. I added PR PalomarSubmission#128, let me know if you want it to have some kind of version cutoff as well and I can add that.
